finalText:
**The build passes now.** One real error was hiding in the noise.

`src/core/settings.js` set `maxRetries: retries`, but there was no `retries` variable — only `env.retries` passed in by the caller. So the build crashed with `ReferenceError: retries is not defined`. I changed it to read from `env` and fall back to a new `DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES` constant, matching the comment right above it.

Build exits 0: `build finished in 41.7s with 3 warnings, 0 errors`.

The 3 warnings are still there and none of them break anything:

| Code | Where |
| --- | --- |
| `W1042` deprecated `crypto.createCipher` | `src/legacy/adapter.js` |
| `W2213` unused export `formatLegacyDate` | `src/utils/format.js` |
| `W3307` circular import | `src/core/graph.js` ↔ `src/state/tracker.js` |

Say the word and I'll clear those too.
